home.IND@HOU: Indianapolis was crushed 7-42 at Jacksonville and fields a defense rated -2.6, while Houston's offense has posted 26-3 and 44-22 blowouts on the road.
home.ARI@KC: Arizona has Minshew and Conner on injured reserve and managed 6 and 3 points in its last two, while Kansas City just won 35-12 and 35-13.
home.BAL@CAR: Baltimore has lost five straight, scoring 10 points three times, and now Lamar Jackson is on injured reserve; Carolina has won at Philadelphia and New Orleans.
home.MIA@BUF: Buffalo ranks 2nd and scores 31.9 per game against a 1-8 Miami offense rated -3.7, and it just dismantled Baltimore 36-10 and the Jets 31-12.
home.NO@CHI: New Orleans' line is gutted with Asim Richards out and Erik McCoy and Taliese Fuaga doubtful, facing a 7-2 Chicago offense scoring 26.8 per game.
home.PIT@PHI: Pittsburgh has lost Pittman and Wilson to injured reserve and just got routed 18-38, while Philadelphia's sound defense keeps games tight, like its 17-19 and 20-24 losses.
home.TB@DET: Tampa Bay may be without Baker Mayfield, with Yaya Diaby doubtful, against a Detroit offense rated +3.7 that just hammered New England 35-10.
home.TEN@DAL: Tennessee is rated dead last at 32 of 32 and just allowed 40 to Jacksonville, while Dallas's +3.4 offense averages 28.6 points per game indoors.
home.NYJ@LAC: The Jets rank 31 of 32, may lose Geno Smith, and scored just 12 in each of their last two, while the Chargers are coming off a road win at Baltimore.
home.JAX@NYG: The 5-3-1 Giants won at Houston and Philadelphia, lost to Washington by just 3, and face a Jacksonville front missing B.J. Green and DaVon Hamilton.
home.LV@DEN: Denver's +2.2 defense meets a Raiders unit rated -3.4 that has surrendered 45, 38 and 35, while Las Vegas scored only 13 last week.
home.MIN@SF: San Francisco is 8-1, scoring 31.2 per game with a +4.2 offense, against a Minnesota attack rated -2.1 that is without Jordan Addison.
home.CIN@WSH: Washington has won two of three, including a 27-10 rout of Philadelphia, while Cincinnati's -0.5 defense yields 21.4 per game and has lost to Pittsburgh and Jacksonville.

away.IND@HOU: Indianapolis already beat Houston 19-17 this season, and the model makes it only HOU by 6.2, so a 12.5-point cushion is far too generous.
away.ARI@KC: Arizona has won three road games, at LAC, LAR and DAL, and the model's KC by 10.4 sits well inside this inflated 15.5-point spread.
away.BAL@CAR: Baltimore's defense faces a Carolina unit rated -1.8 that allowed 43 to Tampa, and the model's 1.8-point margin makes the 2.5 a near coin flip worth taking.
away.MIA@BUF: Miami's last five losses came by 7, 5, 10 and 2 points, and the model's BUF by 13.3 leaves real value against a 16.5-point number.
away.NO@CHI: New Orleans has played one-score games in most outings, including a 1-point loss at Detroit, while the model has CHI by only 8.9 against an 11.5 line.
away.PIT@PHI: Pittsburgh's +1.5 defense faces a Philadelphia offense rated -3.7 that has scored 11 and 10 in recent games, so a 4.5-point cover is clear.
away.TB@DET: Detroit is missing Aidan Hutchinson and Kerby Joseph, and Tampa's +1.5 defense kept a 16-0 shutout, so the model's 5.1 points should hold within the 7.
away.TEN@DAL: Dallas's defense, rated -4.1 and allowing 28.2 per game, gave up 46 to SF, so Tennessee's offense, which scored 36 at Cincinnati, keeps this inside 8.5.
away.NYJ@LAC: The Chargers are 1-8 and scoring just 16 per game, so the Jets' offense, which put up 33 against Las Vegas, can stay within a 3.5-point spread.
away.JAX@NYG: Jacksonville is rated first of 32 with a +3.6 defense allowing just 16 per game, and the model's JAX by 6.5 clears the 6-point line.
away.LV@DEN: Las Vegas scores 25.1 per game against a Denver offense rated only +0.2, and Denver's wins are mostly one-score games, so 10 points is too many.
away.MIN@SF: Minnesota's league-best +5.6 defense allows only 14 per game, and on a neutral site the model makes it SF by 1, well under the 3.
away.CIN@WSH: Cincinnati's +4.5 offense has scored 34 or more in four straight, and Washington is without Laremy Tunsil, making 6.5 points easy to cover.
